name: Abdominal Curl
summary: The basic curl-up: head, neck and shoulders lift as one from a neutral pelvis. The starting shape for most of the mat abdominal work.
steps: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet hip-width; hands behind the head or reaching by the sides.
Breathe in to nod the chin slightly.
Breathe out to curl the head and shoulders up until the tips of the shoulder blades are just off the mat.
Breathe in to hold; breathe out to lower.

layers.title: Oblique curl
layers.text: Turn one shoulder towards the opposite knee.

layers.title: Prop
layers.text: Small ball behind the mid-back or between the knees.

cautions.note: Support the head with both hands or rest between each one.

cues:
Curl from the breastbone; the hands only cradle the head.
Leave a fist of space under the chin.
Pelvis stays where it started.
Belly stays flat rather than doming.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: One hand behind the head, alternating
Small ball or towel behind the shoulder blades
